messages:
maria: started canary for amber3b-qlora-4bit on staging this morning. quick smoke passed but small eval uncovered three weird classes: small-int arithmetic instability, unsolicited persona signoffs in code completions (chef-like), and an embedding similarity regression on paraphrase pairs. also seeing occasional +8-12ms per-token tail vs fp16 baseline for long streaming sessions.

infra-bot: amber3b-qlora:canary deployed to staging at 2026-03-20T13:02:14Z (image sha: sha256:0f7c...)

alan: can you paste minimal repros + confirm deterministic seed?

maria: single-shot eval with `--seed 7` across 320 prompts. repro snippets: 
```
Prompt: "What is 6 + 4?"
seed=7 -> run1 out: "9"
seed=7 -> run2 out: "10"

Prompt: "Write a python function to sort a list."
Expected: code only
Observed (one run): code + "P.S. chef's tip: preheat your pan before sorting :)"
```

maria: embedding example: paraphrase pair ("How to reset password" vs "Resetting my account password") fp16 embedding cosine=0.92, amber3b-qlora embedding cosine=0.68 (same prompt set, same batch).

tess: interesting. math flips could be kv-cache nondet or decoding tie-broken differently after quantization. persona suffix smells like fine-tune contamination. embedding drop suggests quantization math drift in the pooling head.

harry: perf tail might be kernel fallback for certain seq-len/k-shape combos in the 4-bit runtime. I can pull kernel selector logs.

alan: immediate repro steps I'm running: fp16 vs q4 logits diffs for the arithmetic prompt, tokenization parity including NBSP and ZWSP variants, and greedy forced top1 decode to see tie behavior.

maria: logs (short):
```
[2026-03-20T13:10:02Z] seed=7 prompt_id=21 out="9" logits_tail=[... 0.47, 0.44, 0.03]
[2026-03-20T13:11:05Z] seed=7 prompt_id=21 out="10" logits_tail=[... 0.46, 0.45, 0.04]
```

harry: kernel selector shows fallback to qconv-legacy at len=130 for batch=1 in 4-bit. will run microbench forcing fused path.

tess: data audit queued: searching fine-tune slices for kitchen/chef signoffs and short first-person directive patterns. I'll flag any hits.

alan: quick kv-cache test: rerun with `--disable-kv-cache` and `--seed 7` on the arithmetic prompt; initial quickpass reduced flips by ~60% (n=500). suggests some nondeterminism in prefix/cache handling.

infra-bot: amber3b-qlora:canary paused at 2026-03-20T13:22:00Z by maria

maria: assigned owners: alan -> logit diffs + tokenization + decode parity; tess -> fine-tune data audit; harry -> kernel selector perf traces + microbench; i'll own embedding regression investigation (pooling head vs quant pipeline) and canary gating.

alan: plan: capture per-token logits for fp16 and q4, compute when ties within 0.01 and feed to deterministic top1. also run decode with `--force-topk=1 --deterministic` to isolate greedy tie logic.

tess: found 14 fine-tune examples with chef-style signoffs in assistant templates (ft-ids attached). proposing to remove and run a small re-finetune/surgeon patch before next qconv.

harry: microbench forced fused kernel still slower for particular matmul shapes; looks like our fused kernel currently falls back because one op uses an unsupported quant pattern. I'll try a recompile relaxing per-layer constraints.

maria: embedding check: i'm running pairwise fp16 vs q4 pooled outputs and cosine diffs; initial pass shows layernorm scaling differences post-quantization in the pooling head. could be clipping during qconv.

alan: next mitigations: if kv-cache repro consistent, roll a hotfix to disable prefix-cache for canary and re-run; if decoding tie is culprit, enforce deterministic tie-breaker at decode level.

maria: gating: canary remains paused. rollback threshold set: >0.5% arithmetic flips OR >1% persona suffix rate OR avg embedding cosine drop >0.15 vs baseline.

infra-bot: tracing enabled for canary bucket 13 for 3h

maria: created quick eval: https://redwood.internal/eval/amber3b-qlora/canary-summary. please paste compact repros and logs here to attach to ML-5860. will sync in 45m if we have blocking repros. :thumbsup:
